def modify_acc.apply_modify_access
  (ident : Identity) (related_acp : Slice profiles.AccessControlModifyResolved)
  (sync_agreements : Slice SyncAgreement) (entry : Entry) :
  Result modify_acc.ModifyResult
  := do
  let ident_memberof ← identity_impl.get_memberof ident
  let ident_uuid ← identity_impl.get_uuid ident
  let abr ← modify_acc.modify_ident_test ident
  let (denied, grant) ←
    match abr with
    | AccessBasicResult.Deny => ok (true, false)
    | AccessBasicResult.Grant => ok (false, true)
    | AccessBasicResult.Ignore => ok (false, false)
  let amr ← modify_acc.modify_migration_attrs ident entry
  let (denied1, allow_pres, allow_rem, allow_pres_cls, allow_rem_cls) ←
    match amr with
    | AccessModResult.Deny =>
      ok (true, alloc.vec.Vec.new (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8), alloc.vec.Vec.new
        (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8), alloc.vec.Vec.new (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8),
        alloc.vec.Vec.new (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8))
    | AccessModResult.Ignore =>
      ok (denied, alloc.vec.Vec.new (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8), alloc.vec.Vec.new
        (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8), alloc.vec.Vec.new (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8),
        alloc.vec.Vec.new (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8))
    | AccessModResult.Constrain _ _ _ _ =>
      ok (denied, alloc.vec.Vec.new (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8), alloc.vec.Vec.new
        (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8), alloc.vec.Vec.new (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8),
        alloc.vec.Vec.new (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8))
    | AccessModResult.Allow pres_attr rem_attr pres_class rem_class =>
      do
      let s := alloc.vec.Vec.deref pres_attr
      let allow_pres1 ←
        bset.extend (alloc.vec.Vec.new (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8)) s
      let s1 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref rem_attr
      let allow_rem1 ←
        bset.extend (alloc.vec.Vec.new (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8)) s1
      let s2 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref pres_class
      let allow_pres_cls1 ←
        bset.extend (alloc.vec.Vec.new (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8)) s2
      let s3 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref rem_class
      let allow_rem_cls1 ←
        bset.extend (alloc.vec.Vec.new (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8)) s3
      ok (denied, allow_pres1, allow_rem1, allow_pres_cls1, allow_rem_cls1)
  let amr1 ← modify_acc.modify_protected_attrs ident entry
  let (denied2, constrain_pres, constrain_rem, constrain_pres_cls,
    constrain_rem_cls) ←
    match amr1 with
    | AccessModResult.Deny =>
      ok (true, alloc.vec.Vec.new (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8), alloc.vec.Vec.new
        (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8), alloc.vec.Vec.new (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8),
        alloc.vec.Vec.new (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8))
    | AccessModResult.Ignore =>
      ok (denied1, alloc.vec.Vec.new (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8), alloc.vec.Vec.new
        (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8), alloc.vec.Vec.new (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8),
        alloc.vec.Vec.new (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8))
    | AccessModResult.Constrain pres_attr rem_attr pres_cls rem_cls =>
      do
      let s := alloc.vec.Vec.deref rem_attr
      let constrain_rem1 ←
        bset.extend (alloc.vec.Vec.new (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8)) s
      let s1 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref pres_attr
      let constrain_pres1 ←
        bset.extend (alloc.vec.Vec.new (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8)) s1
      let constrain_pres_cls1 ←
        match pres_cls with
        | none => ok (alloc.vec.Vec.new (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8))
        | some pres_cls1 =>
          let s2 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref pres_cls1
          bset.extend (alloc.vec.Vec.new (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8)) s2
      let v ←
        match rem_cls with
        | none => ok (alloc.vec.Vec.new (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8))
        | some rem_cls1 =>
          let s2 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref rem_cls1
          bset.extend (alloc.vec.Vec.new (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8)) s2
      ok (denied1, constrain_pres1, constrain_rem1, constrain_pres_cls1, v)
    | AccessModResult.Allow _ _ _ _ =>
      ok (denied1, alloc.vec.Vec.new (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8), alloc.vec.Vec.new
        (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8), alloc.vec.Vec.new (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8),
        alloc.vec.Vec.new (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8))
  let (denied3, constrain_pres1, allow_pres1, constrain_rem1, allow_rem1,
    allow_pres_cls1, allow_rem_cls1) ←
    if grant
    then
      ok (denied2, constrain_pres, allow_pres, constrain_rem, allow_rem,
        allow_pres_cls, allow_rem_cls)
    else
      if denied2
      then
        ok (true, constrain_pres, allow_pres, constrain_rem, allow_rem,
          allow_pres_cls, allow_rem_cls)
      else
        do
        let amr2 ←
          modify_acc.modify_sync_constrain ident entry sync_agreements
        let (denied4, constrain_pres2, constrain_rem2) ←
          match amr2 with
          | AccessModResult.Deny => ok (true, constrain_pres, constrain_rem)
          | AccessModResult.Ignore => ok (false, constrain_pres, constrain_rem)
          | AccessModResult.Constrain pres_attr rem_attr _ _ =>
            do

            let constrain_rem3 ← bset.extend constrain_rem s
            let s1 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref pres_attr
            let constrain_pres3 ← bset.extend constrain_pres s1
            ok (false, constrain_pres3, constrain_rem3)
          | AccessModResult.Allow _ _ _ _ =>
            ok (false, constrain_pres, constrain_rem)

        let s := alloc.vec.Vec.deref scoped_acp
        let amr3 ← modify_acc.modify_pres_test s
        let (b, v, v1, v2, v3) ←
          match amr3 with

            ok (true, allow_pres, allow_rem, allow_pres_cls, allow_rem_cls)
          | AccessModResult.Ignore =>
            ok (denied4, allow_pres, allow_rem, allow_pres_cls, allow_rem_cls)
          | AccessModResult.Constrain _ _ _ _ =>
            ok (denied4, allow_pres, allow_rem, allow_pres_cls, allow_rem_cls)
          | AccessModResult.Allow pres_attr rem_attr pres_class rem_class =>
            do
            let s1 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref pres_attr
            let allow_pres2 ← bset.extend allow_pres s1
            let s2 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref rem_attr
            let allow_rem2 ← bset.extend allow_rem s2
            let s3 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref pres_class
            let allow_pres_cls2 ← bset.extend allow_pres_cls s3
            let s4 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref rem_class
            let allow_rem_cls2 ← bset.extend allow_rem_cls s4
            ok (denied4, allow_pres2, allow_rem2, allow_pres_cls2,
              allow_rem_cls2)
        ok (b, constrain_pres2, v, constrain_rem2, v1, v2, v3)

  then ok modify_acc.ModifyResult.Deny
  else
    if grant
    then ok modify_acc.ModifyResult.Grant
    else
      let i := alloc.vec.Vec.len constrain_pres1
      let allowed_pres ←
        if i != 0#usize
        then
          let s := alloc.vec.Vec.deref constrain_pres1
          let s1 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref allow_pres1
          bset.intersection s s1
        else ok allow_pres1
      let i1 := alloc.vec.Vec.len constrain_rem1
      let allowed_rem ←
        if i1 != 0#usize
        then
          let s := alloc.vec.Vec.deref constrain_rem1
          let s1 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref allow_rem1
          bset.intersection s s1
        else ok allow_rem1
      let i2 := alloc.vec.Vec.len constrain_pres_cls
      let allowed_pres_cls ←
        if i2 != 0#usize
        then
          let s := alloc.vec.Vec.deref constrain_pres_cls
          let s1 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref allow_pres_cls1
          bset.intersection s s1
        else ok allow_pres_cls1
      let i3 := alloc.vec.Vec.len constrain_rem_cls
      let allowed_rem_cls ←
        if i3 != 0#usize
        then
          let s := alloc.vec.Vec.deref constrain_rem_cls
          let s1 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref allow_rem_cls1
          bset.intersection s s1
        else ok allow_rem_cls1
      let s := alloc.vec.Vec.deref allowed_pres_cls
      let allowed_pres_cls1 ← protected.remove_protected_mod_pres s
      let s1 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref allowed_rem_cls
      let allowed_rem_cls1 ← protected.remove_protected_mod_rem s1
      ok (modify_acc.ModifyResult.Allow allowed_pres allowed_rem
        allowed_pres_cls1 allowed_rem_cls1)
